issues: The second step is incorrectly encoded as buffing Abysscraft followers and using otherOnly. It should buff each follower that costs 1 or less on your field by +1 attack; encode a field buff targeting your followers with maxCost 1 and no exclude-self restriction.

The ability is misencoded as a passive chooseMultiple effect. It should trigger during your turn whenever your leader loses defense, and you choose exactly one option you haven't chosen this turn. Encode this as a triggered ability for leader-defense-loss with per-turn memory of chosen options; add engine support for a timing/trigger like 'onLeaderLoseDefenseDuringYourTurn' and a choose effect that tracks 'not chosen this turn' exclusions.

Option (1) uses an unsupported dynamic amount {"op":"leaderLostDefCount"}. It should deal damage equal to the number of times your leader has lost defense this turn; add engine support for a dynamic amount such as leaderLostDefenseCountThisTurn.

The onAllyEvolve ability incorrectly places the evolved-card restriction in a top-level 'filter' field. It should trigger only when a Nano, the Dawnblade on your field evolves; encode the restriction in a supported way rather than an unsupported wrapper field, so the ability only triggers from that named ally's evolve.

The fanfare is encoded as two separate abilities, causing the NC(20) version to also stack with the NC(10) version. It should be a single fanfare that summons up to 2 qualifying followers, then gives each other follower on your field +3/+3 if Necrocharge (20), otherwise +1/+1 if Necrocharge (10).
summonFromCemetery incorrectly uses maxTotalCost: 2. The source says up to 2 followers that each cost 2 or less, not total cost 2; remove maxTotalCost.
The buff step incorrectly limits the buff to Abysscraft followers. It should give each other follower on your field +1/+1 or +3/+3 regardless of class.

The passive Rush aura is encoded with cardClass at the top level of auraGrantKeyword, which is not a supported field for that operation. It should grant Rush to each Abysscraft follower on your field using a supported filtering field.
